anomalies.observed: On the SkylabModule sheet, the NET0021 label wire drops to a junction at about (928,117). That junction is also the endpoint of the GND wire running left to the GND symbol at about (884,125), and a vertical wire continues from the same junction down into the SKW92A top pin row. NET0021 also reaches J11 pin 14 on the EPD_Driver sheet. The drawing therefore appears to put the EPD pin 14 signal on the same node as ground.
anomalies.expected: NET0021 should be an independent signal (the spec maps J1.14 to a data line driven from the SKW92A) and must not share a node with GND. The GND wire should terminate on a GND pin of U11 only.

evidence.quote: NET0021 label at top of SkylabModule sheet, wire junction at approximately (928,117) joined to GND symbol at (884,125)
EPD_Driver sheet: J11 pin 14 labelled NET0021

anomalies.impact: If NET0021 is shorted to GND, the EPD SDA/data line is held at ground, so the display interface would fail to receive commands or image data.

parsed.summary: The power section, boost/charge-pump circuit, battery diode-OR and matrix wiring match the specification. The one suspicious feature is a junction on the SkylabModule sheet that appears to tie the EPD data net NET0021 to GND, but the drawing is ambiguous enough that confidence is moderate.
